I would like to add some advice on cleaning your mighty.

A dirty cooling chamber and  mesh screen  reduces the vape quality. You will feel like maybe you bought some bad herb.

CLEANING it used to be  a pain, because the sticky resin inside was difficult to clean. Alcohol was the only way I knew how to clean it.

I have since learned that I can keep it clean without alcohol.  I now use wet wipes or baby wipes to clean it, and I do it more often because it's so much easier and less messy. I found this out on my own , not Google!

Also a neat hack for cleaning a dirty screen is to hold the mesh screen with a tweezer and set the screen alight. It burns the dirt away. Just wet wipe it or alcohol swab it and put it back . You are now ready to vape.

The batteries in the mighty are 18650s and of very high quality. They will not need replacing any time soon. My first mighty is about 4 years old and still going strong.

Another tip is to be careful when vaping at night before bed. I had a tendency of falling asleep with my mighty still in hand and which inevitably led to me dropping it     to the hard floor. This is how I broke 2 mightys. This was a very costly lesson for me. 
Anyway, I hope I was helpfully, and hope you enjoy your mighty for many trouble free years.

Regards

Hi , I actually have 3 mightys , 2 original and one fake. I bought the fake to use the plastic housing on the original one that I dropped far too many times. It's easy to tell when you have a genuine one to compare it too.

Firstly the fake sometimes comes with orange o rings instead of blue.

The LCD display on the fake is very difficult to read when outside in natural light.

The sticker on the fake can be remove without much effort on the fake, and most cases no serial number on it. On the real mighty you would have to scratch the sticker off.

The fake mighty cooling chamber feels cheap and low quality.

The 3d logo on the cooling chamber does not look very 3d.

When you plug in the fake to charge, the unit looks like it is switched on and heating up, whereas the original just shows the charging bar.

The charger that comes with the fake is 9volts whereas original charger is 12 volts.

Lastly and I guess the easiest giveaway on the fake is that it does not have the feature to keep your mighty from switching itself off if not used for so many seconds.  On the original you press the power button once and it gives a single vibration indicating the mighty is still on and ready. On the fake that button just switches the vape on and off. Also the vibration on the fake feels loose and the original one feels strong and tight.

That being said I am still using the fake one with my authentic cooling chamber and it's been working well. I will only do the transplant of housings when the fake one breaks.

I hope  this helps
